character.name: Alex
dialogues: Welcome to my space... I hope you enjoy the journey.
This portfolio is a window into my professional and creative world.
I'm passionate about web development and solving complex problems.
Each project here represents hours of dedication and learning.
Ready to explore? Navigate using the side menu.

presentation.title: Presentation
presentation.text1: Jelou! I am Alex, an ecuadorean 20 year old computer engineer that loves playing around with tech stuff.
presentation.text2: Messing around with everything has always been something I love, tearing down everything in front of me, installing electronic devices, or soldering components to create stuff I like.
presentation.text3: I'm kind of lazy, but I do like to work on my own interests. I love what I'm studying.

playground.title: Playground
playground.intro: A cozy corner for the little things I build just because I want to. Grab a mug, poke around — everything here is meant to be played with.

folderView.title: My Apps
folderView.subtitle: Downloadable desktop & game builds — browse the folder like you're on my desktop.

arcade.title: Web Arcade
arcade.subtitle: Small browser games and toys, ready to play — no download needed.

apps.name: Pixel Garden
apps.description: A tiny idle game about growing a garden one pixel at a time. Started as a weekend experiment, never really stopped.

apps.name: Terminal Tamagotchi
apps.description: A virtual pet that lives in your terminal and judges your commit messages.

apps.name: Cozy Clock
apps.description: A desktop widget that turns your system clock into a slowly changing watercolor sky.

snake.name: Snake
snake.description: The classic wall-and-tail dodger, reskinned in a warmer palette. Eat, grow, try not to bite yourself.

sudoku.name: Sudoku
sudoku.description: A quiet little number puzzle for when you want to think about something that isn't work. Three difficulties, zero pressure.
